run_unibench_evaluator: run the unibench Evaluator with a specific model name to evaluate text classification tasks
run_unibench_all_models: run the unibench Evaluator with vllm on all models to evaluate text classification tasks
run_unibench_model_id: run the unibench Evaluator with a specific model id to evaluate text classification tasks
run_unibench_custom_workers: run the unibench Evaluator with custom number of workers for parallel evaluation
run_unibench_custom_output_dir: run the unibench Evaluator with a custom output directory for evaluation results
